titulo: The date on the lid answers it
caption:
The date on the lid answers it

"Is this still good?" "It says Monday on the lid." The question answered itself.

Writing the day on the lid takes four seconds, and it ends the Thursday guessing game.

For whoever puts the day on the lid before it goes in the fridge.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a food container with a blue lid standing on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and a small paper label that says MON pops onto the lid. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me writing the day on it.
